bugs.title: Emergency dispatch confirmation is not rendered in the UI
bugs.evidence: Browser check saferoute-dispatches-emergency failed twice: modal closed, but getByText('Campus dispatch notified') was absent in the failure screenshot. Backend cross-check POST /api/safety/emergency returned 200 with {"status":"Dispatched","location_name":"West Gate","eta_minutes":3}. The frontend imports sonner toast calls but main.tsx does not mount a Toaster.

action_items: Mount the Sonner Toaster (or provide an equivalent visible confirmation) in the application shell so successful emergency dispatch visibly confirms campus dispatch was notified.

checks.criterion: The SafeRoute command center loads with campus status, navigation, map, route planner, metrics, hazard reports, and emergency contacts
checks.name: saferoute-dashboard-loads
checks.evidence: Public preview loaded; header, ALL CLEAR campus status, map, planner, hazards panel, and emergency contacts were visible.

checks.criterion: A student can calculate a safer route
checks.name: saferoute-calculates-route
checks.evidence: POST route flow rendered three route cards including 98% safety score, 620m, 8 min, and Recommended.

checks.criterion: A student can start and complete walk mode
checks.name: saferoute-walk-mode-completes
checks.evidence: Start navigation displayed active escort HUD with North Dorms and 8 min remaining; I arrived safely removed the HUD.

checks.criterion: A student can report a campus hazard
checks.name: saferoute-reports-campus-hazard
checks.evidence: Unique tscheck hazard submission closed the dialog and the new description appeared in recent campus reports.

checks.name: saferoute-dispatches-emergency
checks.evidence: Emergency modal closed after dispatch, but visible Campus dispatch notified confirmation was absent on two runs; backend POST returned 200 Dispatched.

checks.criterion: Dashboard metrics and hazard data are usable
checks.name: saferoute-metrics-and-hazards-visible
checks.evidence: Metrics showed 89%, 06 units, and 04 min; recent report rows showed severity, description, Engineering Hall location, and report time.

checks.name: saferoute-desktop-layout-usable
checks.evidence: At 1280px, map and planner were visible side by side with measured map width above 500px and planner width above 300px.

checks.criterion: Route planning API returns safe route options and rejects same locations
checks.name: test_tscheck_route_planning.py
checks.evidence: pytest passed: POST /api/safety/routes/plan returned 200 with 3 options and recommended illuminated; same-location validation returned 422.

checks.criterion: Hazard reporting API persists and returns a newly created hazard
checks.name: test_tscheck_hazard_reporting.py
checks.evidence: pytest passed: POST /api/safety/hazards returned 200 with created id/location_name and GET returned that id.

checks.name: test_tscheck_emergency_dispatch.py
checks.evidence: pytest passed: POST /api/safety/emergency returned 200 Dispatched for West Gate with ETA 3.

checks.criterion: Dashboard API provides campus status, metrics, and recent hazards
checks.name: test_tscheck_dashboard_metrics.py
checks.evidence: pytest passed: GET /api/safety/dashboard returned 200, 4 metrics, and at least 3 hazard rows with severity/location/description/time.

checks.criterion: Campus locations API exposes fictional landmarks
checks.name: test_tscheck_campus_locations.py
checks.evidence: pytest passed: GET /api/safety/locations returned 200 and all 8 specified campus landmarks.
